name: Naimur Courier Ratio Checker
author: Naimur Rahman Nahid

sections.description:
Are you losing profit due to high parcel return rates and fake cash on delivery orders in your online shop? Naimur Courier Ratio Checker is the ultimate WooCommerce courier analytics plugin designed specifically for the Bangladesh e-commerce ecosystem to reduce return rate and filter out high-risk buyers.

This advanced courier ratio checker automatically integrates with your WooCommerce store to analyze a customer’s order history using their billing phone number. By checking their real-time delivery success and cancellation performance across major courier services in Bangladesh, it helps you make data-driven decisions before shipping a parcel.

With our integrated WooCommerce courier analytics engine, you can fully automate your checkout safety rules. If a buyer has a history of excessive cancellations, this smart courier ratio checker can instantly hide COD (Cash on Delivery) for that specific user, forcing them to pay via secure digital channels like bKash, Nagad, or Cards. It acts as a powerful fake order prevention shield for your store.

🔗 Important Links

  • Select Plan & Buy Subscription: Get API Access Here
  • Video Tutorial: Watch Setup Guide on YouTube

🚀 Key Features

  • Advanced WooCommerce Courier Analytics: Get real-time delivery metrics inside your WordPress dashboard.
  • Automated Courier Ratio Checker: Calculate delivery success percentage of any mobile number instantly.
  • Smart Checkout Automation: Set custom thresholds to automatically hide COD for risky profiles.
  • Drastically Reduce Return Rate: Stop wasting money on return fees by identifying bad delivery profiles.
  • Order List Risk Alerts: See color-coded ratio badges directly on your WooCommerce orders screen.
  • Live API Tracker: Monitor your API limits and subscription plan effortlessly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/naimur-courier-ratio-checker directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Naimur Courier > Automation Rules to insert your secure API Bearer Key.
  4. Set up your custom ratio thresholds.
sections.faq:
How does the analytics engine calculate ratios?

The plugin aggregates anonymous delivery data to return an accurate success vs cancellation ratio for phone numbers.

Will this slow down my checkout page?

Not at all. The plugin features an optimized caching layer that holds data for 5 minutes, ensuring your site remains fast.
